Reference Notes & FAQ

What does Lemon Squeezy's 5% + $0.50 fee cover?

As a Merchant of Record (MoR), Lemon Squeezy handles payment processing, global VAT/GST calculation and remittance, fraud protection, and license key delivery.

Does Lemon Squeezy support bank payouts to Armenia and international countries?

Yes, Lemon Squeezy supports direct bank payouts across 80+ countries including Armenia, with a small payout fee depending on the payout rail.
